validation_scope: Executor reconciliation and invariant checks; not an independent external review.

execution_status.scope: Only v4_validation extension; excludes the prior 120 successful formal windows and their retained failed attempts.

paper_evidence_status.paper_object: Complete RCAPS implemented by V4; V3 is an internal historical condition.
paper_evidence_status.core_direction: Retain integrated placement-routing-execution, with conditional S/T mechanism and explicit latency/work tradeoffs.
paper_evidence_status.modules: conditional effects with substantial M2/M3 GPU-work tradeoffs
paper_evidence_status.space_latency: not robust across tested profile and workload counterfactuals
paper_evidence_status.space_work: work reduction retained in the tested singleton and prompt counterfactuals
paper_evidence_status.temporal: latency gains with measured work costs in tested network/prompt conditions
paper_evidence_status.interaction: environment-dependent; gains must not be added
paper_evidence_status.neighbor: adapted routing mechanism only; three complete triples, one incomplete triple
